subject: English
passage: Originally developed by marine biologists to describe coral bleaching in tropical waters, the term "thermal stress" can also refer to the effects of temperature changes on other ecosystems. In coral reef environments, sudden increases in water temperature can cause corals to expel their symbiotic algae, leading to widespread bleaching. ______ in forest ecosystems, prolonged heat waves can cause trees to shed their leaves prematurely, resulting in extensive defoliation.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. "Similarly" logically signals that the information in this sentence about thermal stress in forest ecosystems is similar to the information in the previous sentence about thermal stress in coral reef environments. In both types of ecosystems, temperature changes cause organisms to abandon their normal biological processes, leading to visible damage.
